notes.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is Out Now! ⚔️
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/f92a4d80d0acad119963abf1a4d58e667ddacae0.jpg

Greetings friends!!!
We have some great news to share with you today.

Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is now available on Steam! We are offering a special 15% discount during the launch period.
The game is also available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/

At its core this is a Souls-like game that features Metroidvania elements, filled with exploration and secrets to be found.

You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey.

Let's celebrate the game's launch!
In honor of the release, please watch the trailer and immerse yourself in the world of Makh-Abyss before fully exploring the story and finding out what actually happened after the death of Lord Derek Ericona.

notes.title: Patch 0.862: Gladiator Arena, Slave Market, Hair recoloring, QoL stuff
notes.content:
Hey guys,
Here is a summary of what happened from the last patch announcement on Steam.
I used to write more often them here, but since Steam has this new system - that I need to add promo-images for each new announcement, check few boxes before and after I have added images - it takes extra time to do it, so I do not post minor updates anymore on Steam.
But I do post each update in Discord and Reddit instead - since it just plain text, and separated posts with gifs about new stuff.

I work alone on this game, so it is essential for me to dedicate most of my time to develop new stuff for my games, instead of trying to make nice Steam posts. To make store pages better - with gifs and stuff - my next task on my todo list. Currently, I think, my Steam store pages - are the ugliest ones around here. I'll fix that soon, I hope!

Big changes in Roal Merchant:
Gladiator Arena - a place where you can put out your team against other player teams. In short: 3v3 PvP.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728226/1bb14e91daf9ba10434a3d64d46401dc2fb1d0d5.gif
Participating in Arena consumes Arena Ticket, which regenerates every few minutes. You get diamonds and honor points for winning opponents.
I put on hold championships - but once few more players will join in - every 4 days - most prestige Gladiators will get extra diamonds and honor points.
Honor points can be used for extra slots in prestige. I'll add later options to buy new stuff with honor points - gladiator pets and some heroes.

Slave Market - a place where you can buy and sell slaves. You can also enslave your heroes here. Why Enslave? In the next update, all your slaves will be taken to the new lands with you. Slaves can only fight in Arena. And you can sell and buy them from other players. They carry their items with them - in preview before buying - you can see slave stats and items.
If someone is selling a Necro - he is carrying all his souls with him. Also, since we all Merchants here - I think this game needs a Slave Master. But I still considering his skills. Should he train some arena skills? Or re-craft items with arena bonuses? Or change DNA of fighters? Should he be a 'crafter' or a 'hero'? His payment definitely should be honor points. If you have an idea or request for him - let me know.

New pets(In next update):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728226/1adc5fbd28d349aaf7b0c96c963d7e60f49c6f9a.png
They were drawn by Sohei, Thx!
I'll add some simple stuff - like buffing your gladiator's dmg and dodge and some other stats. But if you have something special for gladiators - let me know. I'm craving to code something complex =)

What else in my road map for Royal Merchant for the next updates? Spells, Crafter Tiers, More Achievements, More Castle Rooms.
Shout out to "Lord Wayne" for coming up with lists and descriptions. Thx!
We(Lord Wayne mostly) have organized a google spreadsheet - with upcoming stuff. If you want a sneak peek - ping me in Discord.

I want to say thx for playing my games and supporting me. If you have a problem - like a bug or need a steam-key - feel free to pm me. This is a tough year for everyone.
Cheers and happy trading!

reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/royalmerchant/
discord: https://discord.gg/BNE35DF

notes.title: Patch - 0.838: Pets, Outland, Halloween
notes.content:
Hey guys,
here is a huge update - introducing pets, new areas. Most of that is decorated as Halloween but will be expanded with more events.

Pets! The first 5 pets are: Ram, Sheep, Fox, Rabbit, and Skelepider.
Pets affecting all your heroes for all activities. Each Pet has a level and can be upgraded by finding more parts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728226/3601081aa25688194cb267b5118fff3e25987e4a.png

Outland - place where you can hunt down epic bosses. Currently - there is one zone and 5 bosses in it. You can send a party of 3 heroes to any boss. Each day - each zone - regenerate "tickets" to teleport parties instantly to the boss, or reset the whole zone.
Bosses are tough. And they increase own damage with each attack. You probably will need a few runs to kill one.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728226/87dc7ec97dfe67e09f33e25059486bcfac5c9e72.png

PS While I have Art for over a hundred Heroes and Enemies, I do not have many Pets. If you happen to draw pixel-art - pls pm me.

Also, a small buff for favorite weapon +10 dmg. And a few other fixes. Full changelog:

notes.title: Patch - 0.836: Reworked Staffs, Damage Formula, Halloween Event Announcement
notes.content:
Hey guys,
here we go - a bunch of fixes for building your Castle. Tutorial still on the way.
Currently, after building a Castle - you can 'prestige'. Fanсy word for a 'reset' option.

But - I have added a few unique features:
First Prestige will make your life harder: Your melee heroes will attack only from the front position.
Second Prestige will make gathering materials easer: Quests can be set on auto-repeat.
Third prestige will make enemies smarter: Ranged enemies will try to kill fragile heroes.
Each time - your new Castle will give you a boost to certain types of heroes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728226/ad4131f06f90b4d4e1491efec06fc9c5e0aa4264.png
In my plans - I'll add more game mechanics for Castles. In some near future - you should able to merge your Castles to Kingdoms! And pillage and raid your neighbors.
If you d like to add more or have feedback - let me know!

Damage formula was reworked: Now the damage is split to 3: Physic, Magic and True.
Armor works vs Physic Damage, Resist vs Magic, and there is no escape from True damage. Each unit basic damage is eather on of them.
Items buffs damage in two different ways. For example - Staffs:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728226/206f2ad43017935a88611cbdcedb4b7fa29de34b.png
It will increase Hero damage +10 to base damage, and then add +15% magic damage on top of that.
If hero base damage is 90(physic) - equipping this staff - will change it to 100 physic damage + 15 magic damage.

Halloween Event!
I'm now adding it in-game - and it will take a place in a week(or two at most). I don't want to spoil it - but it will be spooky. ([spoiler]and it will feature equipable pets![/spoiler])
